To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

PlantPAN 1.0 is an online tool for detecting transcription factor-binding sites, corresponding transcription factors and other important regulatory sequences, including CpG islands and tandem repeat, and for reconstructing transcription regulatory networks in plant genomes.
the PlantPAN 1.0 is a comprehensive database for plant promoter analysis.
PlantPAN 3.0 provides an informative resource to detect transcription factor binding sites, corresponding TFs and other regulatory elements in a plant promoter or a set.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of PlantPAN 1.0, PlantPAN 3.0 and PlantPAN 4.0.
the development and implementation of PlantPAN 1.0 (PlantPAN) for plant gene expression analysis.

the identification of transcriptional regulatory elements in the plant promoters, the reconstruction of transcriptional regulatory network, and the prediction of gene expression under various conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PlantPAN is a powerful tool for plant promoter analysis.
PlantPAN 1.1 is a useful tool for the study of transcriptional regulatory network in plants.

the PlantPAN 1.0 was a good resource for plant promoter analysis, and PlantPAN 3.0 would be a better resource for plant promoter and TF analysis, as well as for reconstructing the transcriptional regulatory networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

PlantPAN 1.0 has been updated and extended to PlantPAN 3.0 (http://PlantPAN.itps.nckuedu.tw/), which is a web-based database for plant cis-regulatory element analysis and transcriptional regulatory network inference.
PlantPAN 1.0 was a good platform for plant promoter and transcription factor analysis and PlantPAN 3.0 will be a better platform.
the updated PlantPAN 1.0 provides a user-friendly and powerful resource for plant researchers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

PlantPAN 1.0 and 2.0 are the first plant promoter analysis navigator that provides a comprehensive and dynamic platform for plant promoter and TF analysis, as well as for the reconstruction of plant transcriptional regulatory networks.
the PlantPAN 1.0 and the PlantPAN2.0 provide an important resource for plant researchers.
PlantPAN 1.0 and 2.0 are the only plant promoter analysis tools that can provide a dynamic transcriptional regulation network under various conditions.
